system_prompt_style.note: Comet is a skill layer over host agents (Claude Code, Codex...); system prompt belongs to host. Skills injected as SKILL.md; prompt assembly code not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Shape | Inspect the environment, clarify in rounds, and write the brief plus complete target specs
env_context_strategy.note: Navigation done by host agent; 'progressive context' and Project Knowledge injection mentioned in RC.1 but mechanism not shown.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
When enabled, `comet-handoff.mjs` generates a compact
context package that reduces Build-phase input tokens by **25–30%**
context_compaction.note: Classic context_compression: beta, default off; closest value summarize (handoff package with hash references). Host agent compaction not coded.

observation_format.note: Observation formatting handled by host agent platform; not in evidence.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling performed by host platform; Comet exposes scripts invoked via shell (node .mjs).

tool_count.note: No tool schema list in evidence; host-defined tools.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote:
whether
MCP is registered with a supported Agent
protocol_standardization.note: CodeGraph MCP registration with host agents.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Failure returns to Build. Repeated execution errors or no-progress results stop and return control to the user instead of looping indefinitely.
loop_primitives.note: Native Shape→Build→Verify→Archive phases (fixed pipeline) with Build↔Verify repair loop; inner agent loop is host's ReAct.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `docs/comet/changes/<name>/comet-state.yaml` | Portable phase, Loop, acceptance results, blockers, and next action
planning_granularity.note: Classic also stores plan and tasks.md files; Supervisor child-change DAG opt-in.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Runtime runs necessary checks and gives the brief, target specs, acceptance items, and results to a fresh read-only Verifier.
multi_agent_topology.note: Builder plus fresh Verifier subagent by default; Supervisor Changes coordinate multiple agents in worktrees for complex requirements.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Runtime runs necessary checks and dispatches a fresh read-only Verifier

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: No blocking questions; the user confirms the current outcome
human_in_loop.note: Shape requires user confirmation before Build; archive_confirmation configurable (default automatic); Classic auto_transition false pauses each phase.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Portable phase, Loop, acceptance results, blockers, and next action

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: RC.1 also adds manageable **Personal Memory**, **Project Knowledge**, and **progressive context**
long_term_memory.note: memory.learning/retrieval true by default; skills library via comet skill add.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: `comet resume-probe` uses the same configuration to resume through the correct permanent entry point.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Runtime runs necessary checks and dispatches a fresh read-only Verifier

retry_policy.note: Bounded Build↔Verify loop with no-progress stop.

rollback.evidence_quote: let independent Codex sessions or a Claude Code Agent Team implement and verify them in **isolated worktrees**
rollback.note: Worktree/branch isolation; no explicit revert command shown.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Repeated execution errors or no-progress results stop and return control to the user instead of looping indefinitely.
termination_condition.note: Termination by phase completion/archive; max_verify_failures cap.

cost_controls.note: Host-controlled; no cost config in Comet config shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Both Native and Classic runtimes are generated from TypeScript and run through `node` on every platform.
execution_isolation.note: Runs on host via host agent; eval can use Docker.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Native permits ordinary implementation writes only in Build and keeps its phases, schema, directories, and Guard independent from Classic.
filesystem_access.note: Hook guard restricts write paths per phase; hook.allow_paths.

network_policy.note: No network config surface in evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The Router uses `.comet/current-change.json` to send each write to exactly one current Native or Classic Guard.

tracing.evidence_quote:
Each successful progression appends an audit event to
`.comet/state-events.jsonl`

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Comet also covers Skill creation, evaluation, and release.
eval_hooks.note: README states built-in skill evaluation (Rubric, Pass@k, Pass^k scoring). This is skill evaluation, not an external benchmark runner; no line number is available in the bundle.

one write reaches at most one Guard,
